Schema/Index/Btree/Binding/IndexTarget.role: The ordinary table coordinate with its exact inheritance or session role.
Schema/Index/Btree/Binding/IndexTarget.structure: Absolute schema, table name and ONLY flag.
Schema/Index/Btree/Binding/IndexTarget.conditions: Application schemas or pg_temp, with system schemas and physical session internals excluded.
Schema/Index/Btree/Binding/IndexTarget.meaning: The concrete ordinary owner whose checked columns are indexed.
Schema/Index/Btree/Binding/IndexTarget.sql: Quote both table identifier components and preserve ONLY.

Schema/Index/Btree/Binding/IndexField.role: One exact resolved physical column operand.
Schema/Index/Btree/Binding/IndexField.structure: Canonical Identifier and checked integer or Boolean native kind. A completed root identifies its original physical ordinal.
Schema/Index/Btree/Binding/IndexField.conditions: Only int4, int8 and Boolean kinds are admitted at a selected operand slot.
Schema/Index/Btree/Binding/IndexField.meaning: The field from the exact external table declared for use in keys, included payload or a checked index condition.
Schema/Index/Btree/Binding/IndexField.sql: Quote the resolved identifier in each repeated operand position.

Schema/Index/Btree/CreateIndex.structure: Exact owner, sparse ordered slot bindings, ordered key and included parts, typed condition and physical flags.
Schema/Index/Btree/CreateIndex.conditions: Validate every key and covering slot, and every condition leaf, before retaining the detached sorted bindings.
Schema/Index/Btree/CreateIndex.meaning: Matches the same native construction and later writes for the fixed profile and exact external definitions.
Schema/Index/Btree/CreateIndex.sql: Emit the exact operand names and preserve key order, NULL policy, grouped predicate and target interpretation.
